svg.text: SENSOR-AGNOSTIC · BUILT BY ELPIS · DEPLOYED ACROSS DEFENSE, AEROSPACE, AND HEAVY MANUFACTURING
EdgeConnect — the industrial edge runtime that reads
everything, normalizes everything, and ships it anywhere.
EdgeConnect runs on the factory floor as a Windows service or Linux appliance. It reads controllers directly
via native protocols, normalizes every signal to a canonical model, and routes it to MQTT, OPC UA, HTTP, or TCP.
Multi-tenant analytics, OEE via Segments, persistent alarms and incidents, configurable alerting,
PDF and Excel reports, tool-life tracking, and the full PLANT-to-SUB_EQUIPMENT asset tree.
One tenant, many plants, multi-vendor fleets.
DEPLOYED WHERE FAILURE ISN'T AN OPTION
Defense. Aerospace. Heavy manufacturing. AMC-partner ready.
